test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 1 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Select the option that will improve the underlined part of the given sentence.**

Nowadays, many doctors advise __to live in the countryside.__

options.text: to have live in the countryside

solution:
The correct answer is "**living in the countryside**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Options 1,2,3 are grammatically **incorrect:**

 
 
• **Option 1** incorrectly uses the infinitive form in "to have live".
 
• **Option 2** has the incorrect tense of the verb in "lived".
 
• **Option 3 ** has the incorrect infinitive form and tense of the verb "lived".
 
• **Option 4** is grammatically correct. The given option is in the present tense.
 
 

**The correct sentence is**: *Nowadays, many doctors advise **living in the countryside.__***

Hence, the correct answer is** option 4.**
